name: Morton Order Indexing for Out-of-Core Rendering
definition: A data organization scheme that sorts voxel indices based on spatial locality using a recursive z-shaped curve traversal, reducing disk seek operations by storing similar color/function values contiguously.
summary: Morton Order Indexing for Out-of-Core Rendering is a data organization scheme that sorts voxel indices by spatial locality to reduce disk seeks, distinguished by integrating a spatial index with a histogram-based look-up table to manage variable-sized voxelsets.
